title: " And in His name the Gentiles will hope "
subtitle: (Matthew 12:21)
description: Hope for All is a ministry affiliated with the Board of Education of the Evangelical Synod of the Nile. It is a ministry dedicated to preparing and qualifying servants and leaders in the local church, the Middle East, and North Africa to be able to train others as well. The ministry was founded in 2008 by Rev. Dr. Radi Atallah.
